name: unslop-kit
description: Millon15's writing contract — unslop (pstack's 31-pattern AI-tell cutter, vendored and model-invocable), human-brief (headline, a decision block of decided / why it matters / need from you / by when / risk if wrong, then at most 8 flat facts for a human colleague, proof in its own block), cto-brief (five bullets for a decider with the same labels) and unslop-formatting (the figure-paragraph chat layout over unslop and umputun's writing-style). Personal taste — install at user scope.

interface.shortDescription: Millon15's writing contract: unslop, human-brief, cto-brief, unslop-formatting
